column11: what_it_is_and_is_not
Ten sectors on one reporting period, exact mass closure and executable cross-boundary ledgers.

Sector, category and gas for all 100 sector-years - the rectangle is complete since the FY2015-16 recovery; category scope stays partial and the completeness matrix says where. TWO views; only the harmonized common scope may be differenced.

Earlier internal campaign targets retained beside current coverage, timing and allocation diagnostics. Their historical grades are not scientific quality scores or release-completion verdicts for this dataset.

Unestimated streams joined to available activity-based screening quantities, with overlap and scenario assumptions retained. These do not measure national completeness, form a probability interval or enter the central total.

The declared MapSPAM rice surface measured against the own-year GCD-Rice 2023 30 m classification, as within-province ADM2 shares with per-unit verdicts. A measurement of a disagreement, never a surface switch - the fork is priced as the agriculture_rice_gcd2023_adm2 bracket.

One row per (period, stream): the mass beside the support that placed it - geometry, surface, panel, measured located share, priced fallback and ADM1-retained masses, grade, pattern hash and the monthly-support refusal stated per row. Rectangular with typed absence. The audit's three-file hand-join, done once and pinned; never a second allocation.

The OCHA COD-AB 2022 ADM2 frame (160 units, CC BY-IGO) crosswalked to the canonical 152-unit set: twelve of the fourteen collision groups plus Larkana and Tor Ghar RESOLVE, Keamari and Surab stay part_of. The complete, tested preparation for the v1.1 re-rasterisation - and deliberately NOT that re-rasterisation: every shipped shape_id stays on the frozen 2019 frame this release.

The annual 0.05-degree cube aggregated 2x2 at the ODD parity that tiles EDGAR's 0.1-degree lattice exactly (interior 133x169; three half-covered boundary strips declared in coverage_fraction), conservation asserted per layer. A derived benchmark-comparison surface - the frozen 0.05 lattice remains the product of record.

The reference-year crop split measured proxy-vs-panel : within-province shares per (category, shape) under the MapSPAM/cropland proxy product and the PBS district crop panel the allocation reads. The record of what putting FY2023-24 on the panel changed, and of why field burning declined both panels for its own-year FIRMS raster - a measured disagreement, never a second allocation.
The component grain beneath the panel: every priced stream, with its evidence class, for all ten periods.

120 months, July 2015 to June 2025, every non-absent component resolved into twelve months closing exactly to its annual figure. 61.6 per cent of the published monthly mass sits on a flat profile, against 54.6 per cent in the reference year alone. Read a flat month as an allocation, never as an observation.
Exactly 120 rows: what each month's timing rests on, and which sectors a month does not have at all.

The 0.05 degree MONTHLY cube in native gas mass, with district and provincial views, for the reference year. The monthly grain is the reference year's alone; the ten fiscal years are gridded ANNUALLY in pakemis_grid_0p05_annual_ref_fy2015_16_fy2024_25.nc and tabulated at ADM1 and ADM2 in pakemis_adm1_by_year.csv and pakemis_adm2_by_year.csv.

column10: allocation, evidence-graded per stream and period
column11: Ten fiscal periods at 0.05 degrees, three spatial views, three gases, in native mass. Each period is generated from its own atomic streams, NOT by rescaling the reference year's map. Cells plus pakemis_spatial_unallocated_by_year.csv reproduce each period's national control. The views PARTITION the placed mass and must not be added to one another's totals. Whether a period's within-province pattern is its own or borrowed is stated per stream in pakemis_spatial_weights_by_year.csv. Four configuration-specific annual cubes and monthly administrative tables are published; the GHG monthly cube is reference-year only.

Ten fiscal years at ADM1 and ADM2, annually and monthly, under four configurations. Each stream records whether its geography is own-year evidence, fixed, borrowed or substituted. Allocation at district scale is not an observed district series.
The mass with no defensible placement below ADM1, retained rather than spread. National closure is raster plus this.

The 100,000-draw national Monte Carlo for the FY2023-24 reference year, by module and sector, retained for continuity. The conditional native-gas intervals for every year and configuration, with paired trends, are pakemis_ghg_conditional_uncertainty.csv and pakemis_ghg_trend_uncertainty.csv.

A 10,000-draw prefix of the national Monte Carlo carried to months and provinces on one draw_id, with both closure identities holding inside every draw. Profile weights are drawn only where a measured dispersion exists; allocation is conditional, never mixed.
Ten annual analytical bands under three temporal-dependence assumptions. They do not replay every native material flow; current conditional level and paired-trend ensembles are published separately.

Draw-wise paired differences from the legacy analytical graph, restricted to sectors reported in both years. These are sensitivity cases, not substitutes for the current native paired-trend intervals.

The semantic contract: release identity, the dimensions and their values, the defaults, the rounding and aggregation rules, the source digests and the known limitations. Byte-stable and hashed by the release manifest; it stamps no commit.

Typed fact tables (annual, calendar, monthly, ADM1, ADM2, unallocated, uncertainty, completeness, transfers, evidence) whose values are the products' own strings; the only arithmetic is exact decimal products of two shipped numbers, closure-tested.

Dimension tables: the closed vocabularies every fact row keys into (periods on both bases, months, configurations, GWP factors, gases, IPCC categories, geographies, streams, evidence grades, notation keys).

Native nitrogen-ledger replay with no NOx remainder assigned to management/grazing volatilisation. A chemical-attribution diagnostic with downstream NH3 and N2O consequences; no probability, confidence limit or measured alternative.
Native GHG emissions for S_TAN, L_TAN, S_IPCC and L_IPCC; configurations are alternatives and must never be added.
Twelve process allocation months per source and fiscal year; no claim of observed monthly emissions.
Seven core pollutants in native mass with narrower additional species; covered sources only; screening excluded.
Process-specific pollutant profiles with native mass and temporal evidence.
Configuration-conditional native gases and separate GWP aggregates; paired trend ensemble; structural gaps excluded.
Conditional pollutant intervals with shared nitrogen, waste and combustion inputs; no probability assigned to structural scenarios.
FY2025-26 source estimates with explicit partial coverage; cannot be summed into a common-scope national total.
All four configurations at ADM2; fixed within-year geography with source-period evidence and unallocated ledger.
